label: Phase 2 fix contracts.py FieldError on Count('days')
instruction: Update modules/leave_elm/contracts.py to fix the broken Count('days') FieldError in get_leave_application_summaries. Keep LeaveElmContracts with @staticmethod get_leave_balances(user_ids: Sequence[int]) -> QuerySet[LeaveBalance] and @staticmethod get_leave_application_summaries(user_ids: Sequence[int]) -> QuerySet[LeaveApplication]. In get_leave_balances, return LeaveBalance.objects.select_related('leave_category').filter(user_id__in=user_ids).order_by('user_id', 'id'). In get_leave_application_summaries, return LeaveApplication.objects.select_related('leave_type', 'leave_type__leave_category').filter(user_id__in=user_ids).order_by('-created_at', '-id') without invalid annotate(Count('days')). Return only valid Python code.
